title: Receiving of Commodity from Upper Tiers
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.13 and Section 6 (Contingencies) of SOP-02-B, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 107-113 = PDF pages 113-119). Step text is the Key Step column verbatim, with long bulleted detail lists summarised to their lead line. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Coordinate with Supply Officer to confirm the receiving schedule
Receive shipping documents after security check
Check the completeness and validity of shipping documents: Delivery Notification Form, PTR/BL, Materials Safety Data Sheet (MSDS)

Reject delivery according to step 6.1: deliveries with incomplete or incorrect documents shall be rejected outright; fill out the Non-Conformance Report (Annex 3) and have the delivery personnel co-sign the form; inform the consignor, provide a copy to the delivery personnel before departure and instruct to request for a new schedule of delivery
Accept the emergency delivery as communicated and duly approved by the consignor, End-user and warehouse custodian
steps.condition: the delivery is an emergency delivery which does not have a Delivery Notification Form, communicated and duly approved by the consignor, End-user and warehouse custodian

steps.text: Supervise the offloading of the commodities from the delivery vehicle for inspection. Use Manual Tally Sheet as guidance on the receiving
Counter check the dimension and volume of actual carton/cases delivered versus the endorsed dimension and volume stipulated in the Delivery Notification Form

Perform Contingency Step 6.2: inform the Office Clerk on the actual dimension and volume of cartons/cases to facilitate correction in the database if there are any; record the actual dimension and volume of cartons/cases in the inventory keeping records
steps.condition: there is a discrepancy in dimension or volume

steps.text: Inspect actual commodities to verify description/specifications and quantity of each product received against the Delivery Notification Form and PTR/BL. Ensure also that delivered items are suitable to be stored at the warehouse/storeroom in accordance to its storage and temperature requirement
Refer to the latest cold chain management manual of the DOH
steps.condition: the commodities require cold chain storage

steps.text: Perform Contingency Step 6.3: deliveries with damaged/expired items and unmet specifications shall be rejected outright; fill out the Non-Conformance Report (Annex 3) and have the delivery personnel co-sign the report; inform the consignor, provide a copy to the delivery personnel before departure and instruct to request for a new schedule of delivery to compensate for those rejected items and quantities
Accept the items and continue offloading
steps.condition: there are no discrepancy and damages

steps.text: Stacking of commodities: follow the Manufacturer's or supplier's direction regarding stacking (if there are any); stack cartons on pallets at least 10 cm (4 inches) off the floor with no more than 2.5 meters (8 feet) high; place liquid products on lower shelves or bottom of stacks; fragile items shall be stacked with no more than 1.5 meters (5 feet) high; stack of cartons per pallet should fit in to the standard height of rack beams; ensure that there is no reversed stacking of carton per pallet; place cling wrap/plastic wrap on top of the stack to maintain stability during storage and transport

Preparation and/or updating of Bin Cards: produce/update Bin Card per pallet or location for all commodities containing the following information but not limited to: complete item description based on the PO/Contract, unit of measurement, PO/Contract no., supplier, unit cost, date received, quantity, lot/batch nos., expiry date(s), PTR/BL Control Number (if applicable), location code (if applicable). Endorse to the Store Supervisor for counter checking

Location Map - Set the location where the received commodities will be placed. Update location map per pallet or location for all commodities inside the warehouse using the suggested template and/or Warehouse Management System. Likewise, the following segregation to different areas must be observed: Quarantine Area, Storage Area, Staging Area. Endorse Location Map to Store Helper as reference in Put-Away process

Encoding of Inbound Summary Report and Monthly Inventory Report - Update Inbound Summary Report and Monthly Inventory Report using the suggested template and/or Warehouse Management System. Endorse all inventory stock keeping record to Store Manager for counter checking
Consolidate all shipping documents and send to Office Clerk for the preparation and submission of Notice of Delivery (NOD) to Commission on Audit (COA)
Counter check shipping documents, Manual Tally Sheets and Inventory Stock Keeping Records ensuring file copy for future reference

Oversee/supervise all activities mentioned above, ensure that tasks are efficiently performed, and counter check accuracy of all data produced by warehouse staff. Facilitate direct assistance if necessary
